# UE4SSLuaEventBridge v0.3.4-rc.3

- Add eight offline lifecycle integration cases, including 100 fresh Lua sessions, late callbacks, cleanup retries, partial removal failures, and simulated component/subsystem destruction.
- Run lifecycle checks through the normal Lua CI runner and the local Windows development build.
- Preserve user-controlled enablement during deployment, including an absent enabled.txt on fresh installations. Preflight still verifies staged/source hashes while ignoring installed marker differences.

API compatibility remains 4. The native input implementation is unchanged apart from the product version. Packaged enabled.txt remains part of the existing distribution layout; deployment tooling never creates or replaces the user's installed marker.

The lifecycle tests exercise the production Lua helper against simulated engine/native boundaries. They do not establish Unreal garbage-collection safety, native shutdown race safety, or resolve off-thread generated-context cleanup. No new gameplay acceptance or performance claim is made.
